So it's crashing here, which seems to be GDExtension specific code:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/89cea143987d564363e15d207438530651d943ac/core/object/object.cpp#L598
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/89cea143987d564363e15d207438530651d943ac/core/object/object.h#L199

CC @godotengine/gdextension

This seems like it might be the same thing that was fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp/pull/1904

The original Godot issue for that was https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115017
Makes sense. So we'll need extensions to be gradually upgraded to godot-cpp 10.x or later to fix that fully.
